content: If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called, the SOME/IP TP module shall check the value of the Offset Field. If the received Offset Value equals '0' while the received Payload bytes of the previous SOME/IP segments is greater than '0', the SOME/IP TP module shall perform the following steps in the following order: • The current assembly process shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_SomeIp Tp_00054. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_INCONSISTENT_SEQUENCE. • Start the assembly process according to chapter 7.3.1 SOME/IP segment re- ceived with Offset 0
